conventions.composition: InGaAsP: x=Ga, y=As. AlGaInAs: x=Ga, y=Al. Fractions normalized separately on group III and V sublattices.
conventions.av: Positive here, for electron valence-edge shift av*Tr(epsilon). Sign converted from Vurgaftman table convention.
conventions.elastic_units: GPa. Only C12/C11 enters this model; values converted to physical GPa (e.g. GaAs C11=122.1).
conventions.scope: Coherent (001) on InP, near room temperature, direct Γ emission. Hybrid baseline, not the complete original Minch numerical parameter set.
